article.title: The next step in liquid biopsies: urinary extracellular vesicle proteomics in kidney diseases and responses to treatment.
article.abstract: The study "Urinary extracellular proteome in diabetic kidney disease: associations with albuminuria and treatment response" by van Heugten et al. profiles the urinary extracellular vesicle proteome in diabetic patients treated with 4 different therapies. This is an important advance in the field because it demonstrates the utility of such an approach to understand prognosis and responses to therapy in patients with chronic kidney diseases.

score.summary_kr: 본 연구는 당뇨병성 신장질환 환자의 소변 세포외소포체(extracellular vesicle) 단백질체를 프로파일링하여 4가지 치료법에 대한 반응을 분석했다. 단백질체 오믹스 기반으로 알부민뇨 및 치료 반응과의 연관성을 규명함으로써 만성신장질환의 예후 예측과 약물반응 평가에 새로운 바이오마커를 제시했다. 액체생검(liquid biopsy) 기반 비침습적 오믹스 접근법은 정밀의료 구현에 중요한 도구로 제시되었다.
key_points: 당뇨병성 신장질환(CKD) 환자에서 오믹스 기반 약물반응 예측
소변 세포외소포체 단백질체를 통한 비침습적 바이오마커 발굴
다중 치료법(4가지)에 대한 비교 분석을 통한 치료 반응성 평가
score.reason: MFDS의 핵심 영역(오믹스 × 약물반응 × CKD × 정밀의료)과 직접 부합하며, 비침습적 바이오마커 기반 약물반응 예측이라는 점에서 높은 관련성을 보이나, 다중오믹스 통합 미언급 및 EHR/RWD 부재로 최고점보다 낮게 평가됨.

article.title: Interpretable multimodal deep learning for time-resolved survival prediction after hepatocellular carcinoma resection.
article.abstract: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) exhibits substantial interpatient heterogeneity, leading to markedly variable outcomes and survival even among patients with similar stages and imaging phenotypes. Mainstream staging systems remain suboptimal, whereas pathology-dependent factors and high-cost genomic assays are neither scalable nor timely for clinical decision-making. Existing algorithms provide coarse risk stratification or static binary predictions, failing to capture the time-varying risk of death. We developed and externally validated TEMPO-HCC, a multimodal deep survival model with hierarchical interpretability, to estimate individualized overall survival risk trajectories after curative-intent resection. We curated a six-center cohort of 1475 patients and integrated multiphasic MRI, postoperative H&E whole-slide images, and perioperative predictors. A discrete-time survival head generated probabilities at 1, 2, 3, and 5 years after surgery. TEMPO-HCC outperformed unimodal models and guideline-based staging systems, achieving C-index of 0.751 and time-dependent AUCs of 0.836, 0.781, 0.812, and 0.680 at 12, 24, 36, and 60 months, respectively, in the external validation cohort. TEMPO-HCC represents a paradigm shift from static binary classification toward clinically actionable temporal risk prediction. Its hierarchical interpretability provides an auditable evidence chain linking macro-scale radiologic phenotypes to micro-scale histopathologic patterns. Importantly, augmenting guideline staging with TEMPO-HCC improved discrimination, enabling personalized postoperative surveillance and risk-adapted clinical management.

score.summary_kr: 본 연구는 간세포암종(HCC) 절제술 후 생존 예측을 위해 다중모달 딥러닝 모델 TEMPO-HCC를 개발했습니다. MRI, 조직병리 영상, 주변 임상 정보를 통합하여 1·2·3·5년 시점별 개별화된 생존 위험도를 예측하며, 6개 센터 1,475명 코호트에서 외부 검증을 수행했습니다. 기존 병기 체계를 능가하는 성능(C-index 0.751, 외부 검증 AUC 0.680-0.836)을 보여 개인화된 수술 후 관리를 가능하게 합니다.
key_points: 다중오믹스(영상+조직+임상) 통합 AI 모델로 개인화 생존 예측
다기관 코호트(1,475명) 기반 외부 검증으로 임상 타당성 확보
정적 위험분류에서 시간-동적 예측으로 패러다임 전환
score.reason: 다중오믹스 통합, 코호트/바이오뱅크, AI 기반 예측이라는 MFDS 핵심 키워드가 부합하지만, 암(HCC) 질환과 만성대사질환(당뇨/심혈관) 간 질환 불일치, 그리고 약물반응/약물유해반응 예측과 무관하여 부분 관련에 그침.

article.title: Loss of ATP-Dependent Citrate Lyase Drives Left Ventricular Dysfunction by Metabolic Remodeling.
article.abstract: BACKGROUND: Metabolic adaptation and maladaptation are hallmarks of the failing heart and may be a target for therapeutic interventions. For example, sustained glucose oxidation during cardiac stress is associated with increased activity and abundance of ACL (ATP-dependent citrate lyase, Acly), which produces acetyl-coenzyme A (CoA) from citrate and CoA and supports de novo lipid synthesis. However, our understanding of how ACL supports cardiac metabolic adaptation and its potential to modulate disease pathophysiology has not yet been investigated. METHODS: We used human heart tissue samples from healthy donors and patients with nonischemic cardiomyopathy. Next, we used CRISPR (clustered, regularly interspaced short palindromic repeats)/Cas9 (CRISPR-associated 9) gene editing to inactivate Acly in cardiomyocytes of Myh6-Cas9 mice. In vivo positron emission tomography and ex vivo stable isotope tracer labeling were used to quantify metabolic flux changes in response to Acly knockdown. We conducted a multi-omics analysis using RNA sequencing and mass spectrometry-based metabolomics and proteomics. Experimental data were integrated into computational modeling using the metabolic network CardioNet to identify significantly dysregulated metabolic processes at a systems level. RESULTS: We observed reduced ACL abundance and activity in human heart tissue samples from patients with nonischemic cardiomyopathy, which correlated with decreased abundance of Krebs cycle intermediates. Using CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing, we found that cardiac-specific loss of ACL reduces acetyl-CoA synthesis, leading to altered cardiac metabolism characterized by increased glucose uptake and oxidation, impaired energy flux, and elevated AMP to ATP ratios, which collectively promote left ventricular dysfunction. Transcriptomic and mass spectrometry-based metabolomics, as well as proteomic data, reveal compensatory cardiac lipid remodeling and reduced histone 3 acetylation. This metabolic stress promotes activation of AMPK (AMP kinase) and PKA (protein kinase A), which in turn mediates YAP (Yes-associated protein) inhibition through phosphorylation. Stable isotope tracer studies combined with CardioNet simulations demonstrated that increased IDH1 (isocitrate dehydrogenase 1) activity prevents allosteric inhibition of glycolysis from cytosolic citrate accumulation. AAV9-mediated cardiac Idh1 deletion improved cardiac function and energy provision, reducing YAP phosphorylation and restoring downstream YAP signaling. CONCLUSIONS: Our findings suggest that ACL plays a pivotal role in cardiac metabolism through regulating lipid synthesis and cardiac function. Exploiting compensatory pathways of citrate metabolism may improve cardiac function during heart failure.

score.summary_kr: 본 연구는 심부전 환자에서 ATP-의존성 시트르산 리아제(ACL)의 감소가 좌심실 기능 장애를 유발하는 메커니즘을 규명했습니다. CRISPR/Cas9 유전자 편집 마우스 모델과 인간 심장 조직 샘플을 이용하여 다중오믹스 분석(RNA-seq, 질량분석기 기반 대사체학, 단백질체학)과 방사성동위원소 추적 실험을 수행했습니다. ACL 결손은 아세틸-CoA 합성 감소, 포도당 흡수 증가, 에너지 부족, AMPK/PKA-YAP 신호 활성화로 이어져 심부전을 악화시켰으며, IDH1 억제로 개선 가능함을 보였습니다.
key_points: 심혈관질환의 대사 리모델링 메커니즘 규명 - 만성질환 대사 적응 관련
다중오믹스 통합 분석(전사체, 대사체, 단백질체) + 시스템 수준의 대사 네트워크 모델링
동물 모델 중심이며 T2D/GDM 등 당뇨 관련 질환이 아닌 심부전 특이 메커니즘
score.reason: 다중오믹스와 만성질환(심혈관)이라는 핵심 키워드는 부합하나, 당뇨/대사질환 예측이나 임상 코호트/EHR 기반 접근이 없고 질병 메커니즘 규명에 초점이 있어 MFDS 정밀의료 및 다른 과제와의 직접 관련성이 제한적입니다.
